Overview

Data & Lakehouse for AgriFinance & Commodity Markets earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from farm management systems and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. What makes Agriculture & Food Systems different is not the math; it is the operating context: EU deforestation rules governs the data, yield per hectare governs the economics, and the people accountable for outcomes answer to regulators as well as customers. Every design choice below is downstream of that context.
